name: shipment-group
title: Shipment group
description: Items grouped by shipment: where it ships from, the delivery method and window, a status, then the lines that travel in that parcel.
docs: Pass the shipment (where it ships from, the delivery method with its price in minor units and an arrival window as ISO dates, and kind and shipsOn for a pre-order or a backorder), index and total, a status and the lines as children. Give each line its own vertical padding: the group draws the rules between them. With total of 1 the heading is dropped and only the delivery and the lines remain. status writes a badge that follows the shipment from Not shipped yet to Delivered, Delayed or Cancelled, and the card follows it: a delivered shipment says Arrived (pass the day it came as method.from), a cancelled one says nothing is on its way and mutes its price and lines, and a pre-order or backorder only says when it ships until it has left. Change is a button (onChangeMethod) or, with changeHref, a link, and it is only offered while the method can still change: not once the shipment is shipped, out for delivery, delivered or cancelled. Pass canChange to decide yourself. The group is a labelled region named by its heading. Always pass locale; a bare ISO date is a calendar day and ignores timeZone. labels holds every word.
